name: apsara-coding-core
description: Small deterministic repository tasks covering correctness, constrained edits, tool efficiency, and token use.

cases.name: python-order-preserving-dedupe
cases.instruction: Fix the implementation so all tests pass. Preserve first-seen order, handle generators, and do not modify the tests.

cases.name: typescript-safe-chunking
cases.instruction: Fix chunk.mjs so the Node test suite passes, including invalid sizes and trailing items. Do not modify tests.

cases.name: go-normalize-tags
cases.instruction: Fix NormalizeTags so tests pass. Normalize whitespace and case, remove empty and duplicate tags, and preserve first-seen order. Do not edit tests.

cases.name: rust-validated-port
cases.instruction: Fix parse_port so the Rust tests pass. Accept only trimmed numeric ports from 1 through 65535. Do not modify tests.
